reader_summary.headline: My guest today is Vlad Barbalat, the Chief Investment Officer of Liberty Mutual Investments.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Vlad Barbalat, the Chief Investment Officer of Liberty Mutual Investments. Vlad grew up in Soviet Moldova, came to America in 1990. Today we talk about how the mutual insurance structure creates a unique investment platform, what Liberty looks for in a new deal or partner.
